What this is, and what it isn't.

Every word on the first wheel is a curated Sanskrit form, not an arbitrary string. Sentence generation here covers a small, controlled set of singular present-tense sentences. The generated text is intentionally displayed word by word; full external sandhi and unrestricted Pāṇinian derivations are future integrations, not features secretly claimed to exist.

Further research: Siddhāntakaumudī · Whitney · Vidyut. See the expansion plan and rules.
